title: Fade + Slide
description: Phần tử hiện dần từ trong suốt và trượt lên 24 px cùng lúc, dừng êm vào chỗ.

moworks.author: moworks

options.exitAt: s after the start to fade out, no move (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio

moworks.notes: Card: y +24 → 0 px and opacity 0 → 1 together, 600 ms power2.out (easeOutCubic; bezier .33,1,.68,1), both ending on the same frame. Loop 2400 ms: enters at 300 ms, holds, then fades out (no move) in 420 ms power2.in from 1900 ms. Tip: 12–32 px of travel. Params: duration (0.6 s) · y: quãng trượt (24 px) · ease (power2.out).
